assertion.rationale: F1: data-api's external boundary (ingressExternal: true) has no inbound authentication, so the estate's external communications boundary is neither monitored nor controlled for anyone who discovers the FQDN. F2: mcp-tools' external boundary is required to stay open (Copilot Studio calls it from the internet), but the auth gate meant to protect that boundary is inert in the shipped configuration — the control the repo advertises most prominently at its key internal/external boundary is not actually enforced.

recommendation: Set ingressExternal:false on data-api so it is no longer an external boundary at all. Invert the MCP auth gate default and wire MLS_TOOL_BACKENDS plus Key Vault token resolution so the boundary that must legitimately stay external (mcp-tools) is actually protected.
